payload.excerpt: Five destinations ranked on what our own cost guides publish, what that budget buys and who each suits, with every figure in its original currency and the costs a headline number leaves out.

payload.author: [[NEEDS: named author]]
key_takeaways: Value here is our editorial view of what a serious budget buys in quality, guest experience and ease, not the lowest headline price.
We rank five destinations on what our own cost guides publish, what that budget buys, and season and lead time, as an editorial judgement rather than a price table.
Our Santorini cost breakdown, written for weddings in 2027, puts a standard wedding for 50 to 80 guests at €30,000 to €55,000; in our view, that clear tiered budget is why it leads our list.
Room blocks, transfers, VAT and local taxes, planner fees and exchange-rate movement can sit outside a headline figure, so check each quote and get it in writing.
Our Italy cost guide notes that June and September dates are often gone 18 months ahead, while shoulder months such as April and October give you the most leverage.

faq.q: Which destination gives the best value for a wedding at the top end?
faq.a: On our ranking, Santorini, for the clear, tiered budget set out in its card above. Fiji and the Maldives follow.

faq.q: How much should we budget for a destination wedding at this level?
faq.a: Start with your guest count and destination, then use the headline figure in the matching card and add the hidden costs listed above.

faq.q: Are all-inclusive packages good value at the top end?
faq.a: They can be, when you know exactly what is inside; the Fiji card shows what a package often covers, and the exclusions matter just as much.

faq.q: When is the best time to book for value?
faq.a: Earlier than you might think: in Italy, June and September dates are often gone 18 months ahead. The season section above covers the rest.

faq.q: Is a destination wedding cheaper than a wedding at home?
faq.a: Not reliably, because an overseas wedding carries costs a home wedding never does, such as guest rooms and transfers. Our side-by-side comparison of overseas and home budgets sets the two out in full.
